name: @khorsheed/dsh-mission
description: Generic task management: runs of missions with template-declared state machines, deterministic guards, plan data (dependencies / schedules), attempts and checkpoints, append-only annotations, a releasable-state gate for irreversible resources, and gated run-bundle export

compat.notes: slash commands need an interactive UI adapter (web/TUI profile); on headless profiles they are unavailable while the service surface and the CLI stay fully functional. The model-tool face is NOT registered by this package any more: this package's `./tool` composition entry (`@khorsheed/dsh-mission/tool`) owns it, and an agent preset grants it per session (`tools`: all / read / none on that row) — the core row's service surface, CLI, and slash command are unaffected by that choice. The 任务 session tab and its Typert Remote data face (wire namespace `mission`, the `./client` / `./remote` / `./typert` exports) are retired: the human gestures they carried (retry, release check, the gated-export dialog) live on in the eval family's 实验室 surface through eval's own Remote and this package's service face, and the default evaluation preset never showed the tab (ui-spec R6). The session-granted tool row folded back from the standalone `@khorsheed/dsh-mission-tool` companion into this package at 0.2.0-rc.1 (T88, the evaluation-family fold) as the `./tool` composition entry — the preset row id `mission-tool` is unchanged, so a preset's composition state is unaffected once its row name points at `@khorsheed/dsh-mission/tool`; the old package name is retired.
